**Which tool**

**Do you have it installed?**

This matters more than it sounds. An adapter can only be written against real
responses, so the useful contributions come from people who actually use the tool.

**Where does it keep its usage, if you know?**

A file it writes, a command it responds to, or an endpoint it calls. Anything is a
start. See [Docs/providers.md](../../Docs/providers.md) for what an adapter needs.
